blurb: Guests book a time slot to play immersive escape room games lasting up to 60 minutes, with an overall event duration of 80 to 90 minutes including introduction and photo. Teams typically have 3 to 6 players, with 3 to 5 being ideal. The venue also offers a bistro with over thirty board games for additional entertainment.
